children: Dalmia Bharat Refractories sold 2.29 crore equity shares, representing an 11.1 percent stake in RHI Magnesita India, the refractory products and solutions provider, for Rs 825.88 crore, via open market transactions on September 22.
The stake sale was part of the 12.54 percent stake held by Dalmia Bharat Refractories in RHI Magnesita India as of June 2026.
The stake changed hands with four investors at a price of Rs 360 per share.

SBI Mutual Fund was the biggest buyer among the four investors, acquiring 1.67 crore equity shares, representing an 8.07 percent stake in RHI Magnesita India, for Rs 600 crore. Bandhan Mutual Fund followed, picking up an additional 27.78 lakh shares, or a 1.34 percent stake, for nearly Rs 100 crore.
Nippon India Mutual Fund also acquired an additional 24.96 lakh shares, representing a 1.2 percent stake, for Rs 89.88 crore, while Clarus Capital 1 bought 10 lakh shares for Rs 36 crore.
RHI Magnesita India shares rallied 3.04 percent to end at Rs 379.20 despite profit booking at higher levels.
HSBC Mutual Fund buys Rs 34.65 crore worth of units in Capital Infra Trust; L&T sells Rs 50 crore worth of units
HSBC Mutual Fund acquired 45 lakh units of Capital Infra Trust for Rs 34.65 crore at a price of Rs 77 per unit. However, Larsen & Toubro sold 64.9 lakh units for nearly Rs 50 crore at the same price.
Veegaland Developers promoter buys additional 0.55% stake

Promoter and founder Chittilappilly Thomas Kochuouseph acquired an additional 2.69 lakh shares, representing a 0.55 percent stake in Veegaland Developers, the Kerala-based real estate developer, for Rs 3.7 crore.
The shares were acquired at a price of Rs 138.46 per share.
Veegaland Developers shares fell 1.41 percent to end at Rs 139.84 on the NSE, extending their downtrend for another session.
Croll Reynolds International sells 1.21% stake in Mazda

Croll Reynolds International Inc offloaded a further 2.42 lakh shares, representing a 1.21 percent stake in Mazda, which manufactures vacuum systems, heat transfer equipment, evaporators and pollution control devices, for Rs 5.91 crore. The shares were sold at a price of Rs 243.51 each.
However, Sharmin Nasser acquired 1.6 lakh shares for Rs 3.89 crore at a price of Rs 243.23 per share.
Croll Reynolds International Inc held a 7.23 percent stake in Mazda as of June 2026. Of this, it has sold a 2.52 percent stake, or 5.05 lakh shares, over the last three sessions.
Mazda shares witnessed significant selling pressure for another session, falling 4.39 percent to Rs 242.75 amid high volumes.

title: Dalmia Bharat Refractories sells 11.1% stake in RHI Magnesita to Clarus Capital, Bandhan MF, SBI MF, Nippon India
